pendingReview.title: Pasco Deputies Search For Person Of Interest In Port Richey Bathroom Investigation
pendingReview.description: PORT RICHEY, Fla. -- The Pasco Sheriff's Office is asking for the community's help to identify a man connected to an ongoing criminal investigation in Port Richey. Deputies released an image of the individual from an incident that occurred August 26 in the Little Road area. In the surveillance photo, the man appears to be adjusting what looks like a hidden camera inside a public restroom. Authorities have not yet released further official details regarding the specific allegations, but investigators are actively seeking information on his identity and whereabouts. Anyone who recognizes the man or has information related to the investigation is asked to contact the Pasco Sheriff's Crime Tips Line at 1-800-706-2488 and reference case number 26030394. Tips can also be submitted online at pascosheriff.com/tips. Please make a small donation to the Tampa Free Press to help sustain independent journalism.
